decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a renamed and upgraded version of an established trommel that already had a following, so it carries little extra cost and has a fairly secure value.
The AK flail shredder line was fully upgraded to EU Stage V engines and shown at a trade fair, which signals continued commitment to a core mobile line.
The mobile high-speed grinder line moved up to its own page in 2019, so its prospects still look positive and it fits the firm's mobile core business.
The CERON pre-shredders are positioned as setting standards and are already used in plant references, so the option looks to be realizing value despite the stationary segment's higher cost.
